search.empty: f3 == 0 returns (1, 0) without reading any record
search.head_rule: otherwise record 0 is compared first: equal returns (0, skip); greater routes the search to the first run with length skip (or (1, 0) when skip == 0); smaller binary-searches the second run and adds skip to its local index
search.single_run: f3 <= skip searches the first run only, with length f3, and returns its local result
